title: Bartenders
description: Mix and serve drinks or other refreshments to patrons, directly or through waitstaff.
examples: Barkeep, mixologist, taproom attendant, sommelier

title: Wait staff
description: Take orders and serve food and beverages to patrons at tables in dining establishments or at catered events.
examples: Cocktail waitress, dining car server, banquet staff

title: Food or beverage servers, non-restaurant
description: Serve food or beverages to individuals outside of a restaurant environment, such as in hotel rooms, residential care facilities, or cars.
examples: Room service food server, boat hop, beer cart server

title: Dining room and cafeteria attendants and bartender helpers
description: Facilitate food service; clean tables; remove dirty dishes; set tables; replenish supply of clean linens, silverware, glassware, and dishes; supply service bar with food; and serve items such as water, condiments, and coffee to patrons.
examples: Bar back, bar helper, busser

title: Chefs and cooks
description: Direct and may participate in the preparation, seasoning, and cooking of salads, soups, fish, meats, vegetables, desserts, or other foods.
examples: Executive chef, pastry chef, sous chef, fast food cook, private chef, restaurant cook, saucier, food truck cook, banquet cook, caterer, chocolatier, confectioner

title: Food preparation workers
description: Perform a variety of food preparation duties other than cooking, such as preparing cold foods and shellfish, slicing meat, and brewing coffee or tea.
examples: Salad maker, sandwich maker, fruit and vegetable parer, kitchen steward

title: Fast food and counter workers
description: Serve customers at counter or from a steam table; take orders and serve food and beverages; may prepare food and beverages.
examples: Barista, ice cream server, cafeteria server

title: Dishwashers
description: Clean dishes, kitchen, food preparation equipment, or utensils.
examples: Dish room worker, silverware cleaner

title: Host staff, restaurant, lounge, and coffee shop
description: Welcome patrons, seat them, and help ensure quality of facilities and service.
examples: Maître d’hôtel, dining room host.

title: Bakers
description: Mix and bake ingredients to produce breads, rolls, cookies, cakes, pies, pastries, or other baked goods.
examples: Bread baker, cake baker, bagel baker, pastry finisher

title: Gambling dealers
description: Operate table games at casinos or gaming establishments.
examples: Blackjack dealer, craps dealer, poker dealer, roulette dealer, pit clerk

title: Gambling change persons and booth cashiers
description: Exchange coins, tokens, and chips for patrons’ money; operate booths.
examples: Slot attendant, mutuel teller

title: Gambling cage workers
description: Conduct financial transactions for patrons in gambling establishments.
examples: Casino cashier, cage cashier

title: Gambling and sports book writers and runners
description: Post information enabling patrons to wager, assist in operation of games, receive and record wagers, pay out winnings.
examples: Betting runner, bingo worker, keno runner, race book writer

title: Dancers
description: Perform dances.
examples: Club dancer, dance artist

title: Musicians and singers
description: Play one or more musical instruments or sing.
examples: Instrumentalist, accompanist, lounge singer

title: Disc jockeys, except radio
description: Play prerecorded music for live audiences; may emcee.
examples: Deejay, club DJ

title: Entertainers and performers
description: Entertain audiences with artistic expression.
examples: Comedian, clown, magician, street performer

title: Digital content creators
description: Produce and publish entertainment and personality-driven content on digital platforms.
examples: Streamer, online video creator, social media influencer, podcaster

title: Ushers, lobby attendants, and ticket takers
description: Assist patrons at entertainment events: collect tickets, assist seating, locate facilities.
examples: Ticket collector, theater usher

title: Locker room, coatroom, and dressing room attendants
description: Provide personal items to patrons in locker rooms, dressing rooms, or coatrooms.
examples: Coat checker, washroom attendant, bathhouse attendant

title: Baggage porters and bellhops
description: Handle baggage for travelers or guests.
examples: Hotel baggage handler, curbside airport check-in assistant, doorman

title: Concierges
description: Assist patrons at hotels or apartment buildings with personal services and arrangements.
examples: Hotel guest service agent, activities concierge

title: Hotel, motel, and resort desk clerks
description: Register and assign rooms, issue keys, manage records and reservations.
examples: Front desk clerk, registration clerk

title: Maids and housekeeping cleaners
description: Perform any combination of light cleaning duties to maintain commercial establishments, such as hotels, in a clean and orderly manner. Duties may include making beds, replenishing linens, cleaning rooms and halls, and vacuuming.
examples: Hotel maid, housekeeping staff.

title: Home maintenance and repair workers
description: Perform work to keep machines, mechanical equipment, or building structure in repair; may maintain furniture or antiques.
examples: Handyman, roofer, window repairer, house painter, flooring installer, piano tuner, furniture restorer, antique repairer

title: Home landscaping and groundskeeping workers
description: Landscape or maintain grounds using hand or power tools.
examples: Lawn mower, gardener, tree trimmer, weed sprayer

title: Home electricians
description: Install, maintain, and repair electrical wiring, equipment, and fixtures.
examples: Electrician

title: Home plumbers
description: Assemble, install, alter, and repair pipelines or pipe systems.
examples: Plumber, pipefitter, steamfitter, sprinkler installer

title: Home heating and air conditioning mechanics and installers
description: Install or repair heating, central air conditioning, HVAC, or refrigeration systems.
examples: Air conditioning repairer, heating system installer, chimney sweep

title: Home appliance installers and repairers
description: Repair, adjust, or install household appliances.
examples: Washing machine installer, dishwasher repairer

title: Home cleaning service workers
description: Perform cleaning duties in private households.
examples: House cleaner, pool cleaner, carpet cleaner, window washer

title: Locksmiths
description: Repair and open locks; make keys; install and repair safes.
examples: Safe installer, key maker

title: Roadside assistance workers
description: Provide on-road assistance to drivers whose vehicles have broken down.
examples: Tow truck driver, car battery technician, tire repairer, tire changer, car fuel deliverer

title: Personal care and service workers
description: Provide personalized assistance to individuals with disabilities or illness with daily living tasks.
examples: Elderly companion, personal care aide, butler, house sitter, personal valet

title: Private event planners
description: Coordinate activities and arrangements for private events; may provide decor and creative design.
examples: Wedding planner, party planner

title: Private event and portrait photographers
description: Photograph people, landscapes, or other subjects; may use lighting and editing.
examples: Wedding photographer, headshot photographer

title: Private event videographers
description: Operate video or film camera to record images or scenes of private events.
examples: Wedding videographer

title: Event officiants
description: Lead and facilitate ceremonies for life events like weddings or funerals.
examples: Wedding officiant, funeral celebrant, clergy, vow renewal officiant

title: Pet and show animal caretakers
description: Feed, groom, bathe, exercise, and care for pets or show animals.
examples: Pet groomer, pet sitter, pet walker, kennel worker, pet trainer, horse groomer

title: Tutors
description: Instruct students in academic subjects in person or remotely.
examples: Reading tutor, math tutor, language tutor

title: Nannies and babysitters
description: Attend to children in businesses or private households; perform tasks like dressing, feeding, bathing.
examples: Au pair, child sitter at hotels and gyms

title: Visual artists
description: Create original visual artwork using any of a wide variety of media and techniques.
examples: Ice sculptor, caricature sketch artist

title: Floral designers
description: Design, cut, and arrange live, dried, or artificial flowers and foliage.
examples: Corsage maker, florist, flower arranger, event florist

title: Skincare specialists
description: Provide skincare treatments to face and body to enhance appearance.
examples: Facialist, electrologist, spa esthetician

title: Massage therapists
description: Perform therapeutic massages of soft tissues and joints; may assist in assessment and therapy plans.
examples: Masseuse, deep tissue massage therapist, sports massage therapist

title: Barbers, hairdressers, hairstylists, and cosmetologists
description: Provide beauty or barbering services like cutting, coloring, styling hair, scalp treatments, shaving.
examples: Wig stylist, beautician, hair colorist, hair cutter

title: Shampooers
description: Shampoo and rinse customer’s hair.
examples: Scalp treatment specialist, shampoo assistant

title: Manicurists and pedicurists
description: Clean and shape customers' fingernails and toenails; may polish or decorate nails.
examples: Nail technician, fingernail sculptor, nail painter

title: Eyebrow and eyelash technicians
description: Enhance and maintain clients' eyebrows using threading, waxing, or tweezing. Enhance clients' eyelashes using tinting or applying extensions.
examples: Eyebrow waxer

title: Makeup artists
description: Design and apply makeup looks.
examples: Wedding makeup artist, party makeup artist

title: Exercise trainers and group fitness instructors
description: Instruct or coach groups or individuals in exercise activities for personal fitness.
examples: Aerobics trainer, yoga instructor, personal trainer

title: Tattoo artists and piercers
description: Design and execute tattoos; create openings for jewelry and advise on aftercare.
examples: Tattoo artist, ear piercer, nose piercer

title: Tailors
description: Design, make, alter, repair, or fit garments.
examples: Tailor, seamstress, clothing alterations worker

title: Shoe and leather workers and repairers
description: Construct, decorate, or repair leather products such as luggage and shoes.
examples: Cobbler, shoe shiner

title: Golf caddies
description: Assist a golfer during a round by carrying bag, advising on play.
examples: Golf caddie, golf cart attendant

title: Self-enrichment teachers
description: Teach individuals/groups for self-enrichment (non-occupational).
examples: Knitting instructor, piano teacher, art instructor, dance teacher

title: Recreational and tour pilots
description: Pilot aircraft for recreational or touring purposes (excludes commercial airline pilots).
examples: Helicopter tour pilot, hot air balloon aeronaut, skydiving pilot

title: Tour guides
description: Guide individuals or groups on sightseeing tours.
examples: Museum guide, sightseeing guide

title: Travel guides
description: Plan and conduct long-distance travel, tours, and expeditions.
examples: Cruise director, river expedition guide

title: Sports and recreation instructors
description: Teach sports or recreational skills for leisure.
examples: Diving instructor, ski instructor, tennis teacher, surfing instructor

title: Parking and valet attendants
description: Park vehicles or issue tickets for customers in a parking lot or garage; may collect fee.
examples: Parking garage attendant, valet parker

title: Taxi and rideshare drivers and chauffeurs
description: Drive a motor vehicle to transport passengers on a planned or unplanned basis.
examples: Cab driver, personal driver, platform/app-based rideshare driver

title: Shuttle drivers
description: Drive a motor vehicle to transport passengers on a planned route and scheduled basis. Excludes municipal bus and school bus drivers.
examples: Airport shuttle driver, hotel shuttle driver, rental car shuttle driver

title: Goods delivery people
description: Drive truck or other vehicle to deliver goods, such as food products, appliances, or furniture, or pick up or deliver packages. May also take orders or collect payment at point of delivery.
examples: Pizza delivery driver, grocery delivery driver, floral delivery, bicycle courier, package delivery person, appliance delivery driver, furniture delivery person, app/platform-based delivery person

title: Personal vehicle and equipment cleaners
description: Wash or otherwise clean personal vehicles and equipment.
examples: Car wash attendant, auto detailer, boat waxer

title: Private and charter bus drivers
description: Drive bus or motor coach for charters or private carriage; may assist with baggage.
examples: Motor coach bus driver, tour bus driver

title: Water taxi operators and charter boat workers
description: Operate water taxi boats or provide services to passengers on private charter boats.
examples: Water taxi captain, air boat operator, charter boat deckhand, charter boat steward

title: Rickshaw, pedicab, and carriage drivers
description: Operate rickshaw, pedicab, or carriage to transport passengers.
examples: Horse drawn carriage driver, bike taxi driver

title: Home movers
description: Manually move furniture, instruments, art, boxes, luggage to/from homes.
examples: Furniture mover, packer, piano mover, art mover

title: Gas pump Attendant
description: Pump gas for customers at a gas station. May also clean the windshield, check the oil level, or check the tire pressure of the customer's car during refueling.
examples: Gas pumper
